games.name: REALISTIC HOOD TESTING
games.desc:
Game Is in Alpha Stage – Expect Bugs

This game is a "hood" gun testing experience focused on firearms, vehicles, and environments. It is not a full-fledged game but rather a casual and experimental test space. This game is inspired by "REALISTIC HOOD GUN TEST," the Original "REALISTIC HOOD," and MiscGunTest. 

[How To Play]
- Choose from 150+ guns and test them all out!
- Visit the Firearm Store to customize your weapons with Optics, Lights, Lasers, Foregrips, and more!
- Spawn with a randomized loadout and engage in PvP battles against other players.
- Experiment with a variety of weapons, each featuring different calibers and mechanics.

Supported Platforms: Mobile, Tablet, PC, Xbox, and PlayStation

Credits:

*Scripter: @watamelnKalashnikov

games.name: Flicker 💡
games.desc:
UPDATE 4.4
- New Black Creek House map! 🏚️ This modest house sits on a quiet street. The neighbors always see people going in, but never see them coming out...
- New Party system to play with friends! 🤝 You can now join a party with your friends in the lobby to guarantee that you queue into the same match together.
- New Twin Whisper ability! 🤫 Twins can toggle a Whisper mode that shows messages only to their Twin.
FULL UPDATE LOG: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1188352

flick... flick... 
When the lights go out, the murderer strikes.

Flicker is a social deduction game where you must use clues and intuition to eliminate your enemies. Everyone has a hidden ability, but not everyone may be telling the truth about what theirs is. Interrogate suspects, tell fates, protect others, point fingers, help the killer evade capture... or be the killer everyone is searching for.

games.name: Seeker vs Hider
games.desc:
Welcome to the Deadliest Game of Hide and Seek!

HIDERS: Stay hidden from the Seeker until the round ends. Once time runs out, it’s your chance to take the Seeker down and win!

SEEKER - Find all the Hiders before time runs out. If you don’t, it’s your turn to survive until the end and avoid being taken out!

Don’t forget to like, favorite, and join the group!

GAME IS IN TESTING. EXPECT BUGS AND SERVER MIGRATIONS

CONTROLS PC:
C/X - Crouch, Stand
R/M1 - Reload
F/M1 - Chamber
M1 - Fire
M2 - Aim
P - Ragdoll

CONTROLS CONSOLE:
A/X - Jump
B/⭘ - Crouch, Stand
X/☐ - Reload
Y/△ - Ragdoll
RT - Fire
LT - Aim
